new_commodity_proposals.term: Frozen Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Bites
new_commodity_proposals.evidence: Frozen, fully cooked, breaded white-meat chicken in 1.5-3 lb bags (Just Bare, Tyson, Kirkland) at roughly $6-9/lb - three to four times raw breast per lb, and part of the weight is breading. The pre-resolver found no vocabulary row sharing a core word and its board sweep for this term returned only chicken-breast, which is the standing fresh/frozen form-flip rejection. If an id already prices frozen breaded chicken (e.g. a nugget or tender id under another spelling), alias to it rather than minting.

Soft mozzarella packed in water, sold in 8 oz tubs/logs at roughly twice low-moisture mozzarella per oz, with a different moisture basis; the existing mozzarella-cheese, reduced-fat-mozzarella and burrata rows are all different products. The pre-resolver reports no commodity claims it although today's captures carry matching products, and a 2026-08-26 ruling already used this id.

registrar_rulings.reason: No id prices whole-muscle breaded chicken anywhere in the estate: the nearest live row is chicken-nuggets, whose crown is Kirkwood Family Size Chicken Nuggets 48 oz at $0.1435/oz (Aldi) - a formed/ground product at roughly one-third the $6-9/lb (~$0.38-0.56/oz) whole-breast-bite class, so a nugget floor would misprice every recipe using this line by ~3x. chicken-nuggets' include is only 'chicken\s+nuggets?' and will not claim 'breast bites' products; canned-chicken explicitly EXCLUDES 'strips|bites|nuggets|patties|tenders' (commodities.json line 66495), and the estate's only '\btenders?\b' and 'tender bites' strings sit inside other commodities' exclude lists - evidence the class was deliberately kept out of existing ids, not carried under another spelling. chicken-breast is the standing fresh-vs-frozen-breaded form-flip rejection. Verdict: SAME FOOD, DIFFERENT FORM vs chicken-nuggets (whole-muscle vs formed) and vs chicken-breast (raw vs cooked-breaded). Follow-up edits: mint in the RECIPE-ONLY namespace (recipe-board-everyday baseline + recipe-commodities.json, it does go on sale); include patterns around 'chicken\s+breast\s+(?:bites|chunks|pieces)' and 'lightly\s+breaded\s+chicken\s+breast', with real excludes at neighboring rigor (~150) covering nugget, patty, tender(s), strips, popcorn, fritter, dino, raw, canned, plant-based/Daiya-style; add commodity-dupe-allowlist.json pairs breaded-chicken-breast-bites<->chicken-nuggets ('whole-muscle breaded breast vs formed nuggets, ~3x per-oz') and breaded-chicken-breast-bites<->chicken-breast ('cooked breaded frozen vs raw fresh') so the daily audit never re-flags them. No sibling collision: proposal 2 is cheese.

The dossier's near-row list omitted the decisive rows, so I re-derived them: the live feed carries mozzarella-cheese at $0.1521/oz and reduced-fat-mozzarella at $0.18/oz, and every product name under both board rows is shredded LOW-MOISTURE part-skim (Member's Mark Part-Skim Shredded, Great Value Low-Moisture Part-Skim, Happy Farms Shredded) - the sun-dried-tomatoes check applied: the existing crowns are demonstrably NOT the water-packed product, so this is not the same purchase under another spelling. No burrata id exists anywhere in the three namespaces or the feed despite the mapper citing one. block-cheese's include ('block cheese/chunk') and the daiya row don't claim water-packed tubs/logs. fresh-mozzarella itself has no price cell today, and the 2026-08-26 mapper ruling already committed recipes to this exact id. Verdict: SAME FOOD, DIFFERENT FORM (water-packed high-moisture vs low-moisture shredded, ~2x per-oz and a different moisture/yield basis) - a legitimate new id. Follow-up edits: mint in the RECIPE-ONLY namespace (recipe-board-everyday baseline + recipe-commodities.json); include patterns around 'fresh\s+mozzarella', 'mozzarella.{0,20}(?:in\s+water|water[- ]packed)', 'ciliegine|bocconcini|ovoline', with excludes for shredded, low[- ]moisture, part[- ]skim, string/stick, smoked, burrata, breaded, daiya/plant-based at neighboring rigor; add commodity-dupe-allowlist.json pairs fresh-mozzarella<->mozzarella-cheese and fresh-mozzarella<->reduced-fat-mozzarella ('water-packed fresh vs low-moisture shredded, different moisture basis'). SEPARATE vocabulary answer per the two-namespace rule: 'Fresh Mozzarella' also needs its own db\ingredients.json row (none exists; reduced-fat-mozzarella's row is a different form) - a distinct edit this id ruling does not perform.

macro_cross_check: Done by hand over all 8 lines at source scale, 6 servings. Ours 496 cal / 40.7 protein / 34.4 carbs per serving vs source 500 / 43 / 31. Calories 0.8% low, protein 5.3% low, carbs 11% high - all inside tolerance, no portion looks wrong. Note this check is what identified the chicken: the FDC shelf's generic breaded tender (263 cal, 14.7 P per 100 g) gives 569 cal and 37 g protein, a worse fit on both axes, while the Just Bare label reconciles the source almost exactly. Band check: 496 cal in 450-800 OK, protein 40.7 clears the 40 floor but with LITTLE MARGIN - if the parmesan or mozzarella weight is later trimmed this recipe can fall under the floor.
